description: This file defines a migration class for version 4.1.2 of the OrangeHRM system. The class extends an abstract migration class and implements methods to modify database entries related to user roles and module default pages, specifically updating the 'time' module's default page priority to 200 for the Admin role.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Defines a database migration for updating default page priorities for the 'time' module and the 'Admin' user role in OrangeHRM version 4.1.2.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration by updating the default page priority for the 'time' module for the Admin user role to 200.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.1.2' indicating the migration's target version.
